canvas.background_rule: perfectly flat chroma key without shadow, gradient, texture, floor or reflection

immutable_locks.identity: Approximately four heads tall with the same rounded face, muted blue-gray eyes, ash-blonde chin-length bob and large navy beret.
immutable_locks.proportion: Preserve head and face size, shoulder width, dress volume, hem height, leg thickness, shoe size, scale and margins from the selected pose-family authority.
immutable_locks.costume: Deep navy dress, cream Peter Pan collar and lace hem, orange neck ribbon, three brass buttons, cream knee socks and black Mary Jane shoes remain topologically identical.
immutable_locks.hair_material: Ash-blonde hair retains the original restrained warm highlights; do not brighten, bleach, add stripes, grain or high-frequency texture.
immutable_locks.accessories: One tan cross-body satchel remains on the character's fixed side with one connected strap and exactly one white rabbit with orange bow.
immutable_locks.rendering: Soft polished anime game illustration, fine dark outlines, restrained warm shading, orthographic camera, neutral light and no cast shadow.

authority_rule: Design authority owns identity and surface treatment; the selected pose-family authority owns geometry; approved temporal neighbors own motion and contacts only.

normalization.baseline_policy: Declare per action; standing in-place actions lock the foot baseline, airborne or seated-contact transfers keep the fixed pivot but may disable alpha-bound baseline locking.
